newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine telecom firms install 1.489 mln lines.
newsitem.headline: Philippine telecom firms install 1.489 mln lines.

text.p: Local telecommunication companies were able to install 1.489 million lines in 1996, or only 26.68 percent of their obligations, the National Telecommunications (NTC) said.
Documents released by the NTC showed the ten companies are supposed to install 5.582 million lines within a three-year period which ends in 1998 for most of the companies.

"At this pace, many of the new local operators might not meet their obligations with only a few months left. They have to hasten implementation," Communications Undersecretary Josefina Lichauco told reporters.
The NTC said only three companies complied with their obligations for the period - Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co, Globe Telecom GMCR Inc and ICC Telecom, a unit of Benpres Holdings Corp.

The firms and their installed telephone lines are as follows: PLDT (656,510), Globe (109,686), ICC Telecom (338,870), Isla Communications Co Inc (6,594), Philippine Global Communications (45,502), Philippine Telegraph & Telephone Corp (50,000), and Smart Communications Co Inc, a unit of Metro Pacific Corp (161.700).
Two companies, Pilipino Telephone Corp and Eastern Telecommunications Philippines Inc have yet to start their rollout implementation.
